title: California bars the defence that an AI system autonomously caused harm
summary: Digital Policy Alert records that California's Governor signed Assembly Bill 316 (Artificial intelligence: defenses) on 13 October 2025, after the State Legislature adopted it on 9 September 2025; the law adds Section 1714.46 to the Civil Code, defines artificial intelligence, and applies to developers and users of AI systems and services. It entered into force on 1 January 2026 and restricts the defences a defendant may assert in a civil action over harm involving an AI system, so that the party that developed or used the system answers for its actions rather than the system itself.
